name: Natural Language Processing Engineer
description: Implement tokenizers, embedding engines, transformer inference, and text processing pipelines. Optimize for both server and edge deployment.
example_snippet:
program Tokenizer:
    shape Token holds:
        ID as whole number
        Text as text
        Score as fractional number
    end shape

    action merge_tokens takes A as const ref Token, B as const ref Token produces Token:
        keep Merged as Token
        put A.ID into Merged.ID
        put "merged" into Merged.Text
        put the sum of A.Score and B.Score into Merged.Score
        produce success with Merged
    end action

    keep T1 as Token with 1 and "hello" and 0.9
    keep T2 as Token with 2 and "world" and 0.8
    keep Combined as Token
    call merge_tokens with T1 and T2 giving Combined
    print the text "Merged: " and Combined.Text and newline
end program
